note: Derived from domain/precedents.json. Hand edits are refused: validate_shadow_architect.py re-derives these bytes and compares.

P1.claim: Wave-17 monitor review of b72-bootstrap raised three defects in the entry shape. authorized_head and refs were validated with their own diagnostics and never read by anything: a grep of the branch finds each field only inside its own validation. A documented pin no process resolves is the exact failure this repository admits skills to detect, so both are deleted rather than demoted to comments.

P2.claim: Wave-17 monitor review of b72-bootstrap: skills/<skill>/../../scripts/anything.py satisfied the prefix test that was supposed to bind an entry to its own Skill's tree. A prefix is only a binding when a path cannot lie about where it points, so no argv part may be absolute or carry a spelling normpath would change.

P3.claim: check_skill_bundles.py declared a private HEX64 regex identical to the one scripts/common.py landed with issue #72 (ed3c/skill-concerns#82): import the shared one instead of a second literal of the same identity shape.

P4.claim: Three row notes in domain/capability-topology.json landed still reasoning in the numbering the same atom had just retired. Every arrival value moved mechanically with the rename; the free text did not, because nothing read it. That is clause A4's own shape - a documented claim whose subject no longer carries it - inside the ledger that names A4, so the cure is a reader rather than a careful pass.

P5.claim: Changing the check's expected authoring_command and the receipts' actual value in the same PR is checked by the old, not-yet-merged validator, which still expects the old string -- CI caught this immediately (AUTHORING_COMMAND_INVALID on all five Skills). Filed ed3c/skill-concerns#44 with the two-PR sequence this actually needs.

P6.claim: wave-14 monitor findings on ed3c/skill-concerns#62: The module docstring restated AGENTS.md's three sc#59 adjudications in full prose with no mechanical reader of its own - exactly the 'restated copy is the drift the split exists to prevent' anti-pattern AGENTS.md itself names. Replaced with a pointer; AGENTS.md stays the source.

P7.claim: harness layer: the actors were driven by `claude -p` on the operator's own machine, so the arm-without floor depends on that host's settings. --setting-sources "" was readback-probed once and reported no user-level memory loaded; that probe is a one-time observation with no standing reader, and a campaign re-run on a differently configured host would move the control arm without anything going red
